stories.title: Follow live: Divisional rivals get the postseason started in Atlanta
stories.summary: Eight teams enter wild-card week; only four can make it out. We've got it all covered for you.

stories.title: Sources: Giants to release OBJ amid veteran receiver's struggles
stories.summary: The Giants are releasing veteran wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr., sources told NFL Network.

stories.title: Judge won't play ALWCS vs. Red Sox, but Stanton makes Yankees' roster
stories.summary: Aaron Judge will not play for the Yankees in the AL Wild Card series, but Giancarlo Stanton -- who hasn't played in over five months -- was included on the roster.

stories.title: Premier League finds Man City guilty on all charges of financial breaches
stories.summary: Manchester City have been found guilty of all 115 charges of serious breaches of Premier League regulations, the Premier League confirmed in a 1545-word statement on Tuesday.

stories.title: Cowboys owner Jones: 'No explanation' for late coaching gaffes in Rio
stories.summary: Jerry Jones says he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff cost the Cowboys a victory over the Ravens.
